title: Hide Navigate and Reverse Transaction on sustainability posting preview
summary: Navigation and reverse transaction actions are now hidden on sustainability posting preview rows to prevent confusing users with non-functional operations.
key_points: Hide Navigate, Reverse Transaction, and Collected G/L Entries actions on sustainability entry pages when displaying preview rows
Uses a two-part check: temporary buffer plus preview document number to distinguish preview rows from live posted entries
Preview document number pattern is centralized in Sust. Preview Post Instance codeunit
Analysis View drill down continues to work with real posted entries in temporary buffers
No schema changes or new objects added
quote: Preview rows carry a negative placeholder key and a placeholder document number of three asterisks, so Reverse Transaction matches nothing and silently does nothing.
